description: Record the caller's symptoms and smoking status once you have them. Returns the exact sentence to say back to the caller, or the questions still to ask.
name: record_intake

smoking.description: Smoking status. Use unknown if not asked or not answered.

code.description: Symptom code. HAEMOPTYSIS_REPEATED = blood in sputum more than once. HAEMOPTYSIS_MASSIVE means a large amount of blood, including blood filling a tissue or lots of blood with each cough. DYSPNOEA_SEVERE means severe breathlessness at rest right now. CHEST_PAIN_ACUTE_SEVERE means sudden severe chest pain. These are emergencies: do not ask more questions; tell the caller to hang up and call 112 now.

durationDays.description: How long the symptom has lasted, in days. Omit if the caller did not say.

quote.description: The caller's own words for this symptom, verbatim.

knownCause.description: A cause the caller gave for this symptom, e.g. 'fell skiing'. Omit if none.

observations.description: One entry per symptom the caller described.
